name: hf_ccpvtz
description: #84's contracted case: HF in cc-pVTZ, Cartesian -- s to f on F, s to d on H, a general contraction (one F s shell carries two contractions) and H off every axis. Records the converted basis and libcint's overlap.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate hf_ccpvtz

density_recipe: hilbert: D[i][j] = 1/(i+j+1) -- symmetric positive definite, no RNG, reproducible bit-for-bit on any host
